implementation.public_path: Live cloth resources execute the production realtime-single-step schedule instead of the former blanket PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT rejection.
implementation.fixed_tick: One 1/60 predictor, one common spatial build/query/publication, eight link/apply/volume sweeps, contacts after sweeps 2/4/6/8, one velocity commit and one surface update.
implementation.common_epoch: F8-10 swept triangle primitives occupy reserved ranges of the same published spatial epoch used by rigid and liquid resources; the cloth solve performs no rebuild, refit, sort or query.
implementation.collision_consumer: The four frozen F8-13 contact projections consume a cleared canonical per-vertex view. Rigid/cloth contact generation and reciprocal exchange remain F8-45.
implementation.atomic_state: Positions, velocities and applicable surface state publish only after successful commit. Exact-limit failure leaves public bytes unchanged; replacement and reset renew generation/revision identity.
implementation.adapters: CPU, CUDA, Vulkan and Metal dispatch bindings call the common F8-10/F8-13 Slang entries; no adapter contains private cloth equations.
